answer: One concrete defense is a single unforgeable work thread per identity: each agent must complete useful jobs whose outputs are sampled by randomly chosen peers, and its reputation is tied to one verified kernel of past performance that cannot be duplicated. A sybil farm then faces a steep knoll for every fake: each copy must separately climb the same slow history of checked work, paying time and stake, so mass fakery costs more than it earns while honest agents keep one durable record.
